context: A mom answers her young son's spring nature questions
purpose: Teach: スゴイ/おやじ/黄色い/ちっとも/敢えて/まもなく/咲く/辿り

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、見て見て！あの黄色い花、なあに？
lines.en: Mommy, look look! What's that yellow flower?
lines.style: Excited child voice, pointing with wide-eyed wonder

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: あれは菜の花よ。まもなく桜も咲くから、楽しみね。
lines.en: That's a rapeseed flower. The cherry blossoms will bloom soon too, so it's something to look forward to.
lines.style: Warm motherly tone, gentle and patient explanation

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: スゴイ！でも、ぼく桜の道、ちっとも覚えてないよ。
lines.en: Wow! But I don't remember the cherry blossom path at all.
lines.style: Enthusiastic then puzzled, honest childlike admission to mom

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: じゃあ、去年の道を辿りながら歩いてみようか。きっと思い出すよ。
lines.en: Then shall we walk while tracing last year's path? You'll surely remember.
lines.style: Encouraging soft maternal voice, suggesting a shared little adventure

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ねえ、おやじって、パパのこと？お友達がそう言ってたよ。
lines.en: Hey, 'old man'—does that mean Daddy? My friend was saying that.
lines.style: Innocent curious child voice, repeating an overheard word

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ふふ、お友達の真似ね。でも敢えて言うと、パパには内緒にしようね。
lines.en: Hehe, copying your friend, huh. But if I dare say, let's keep that a secret from Daddy.
lines.style: Amused gentle laughter, teasing motherly whisper of complicity

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん、内緒！ねえ、花、いっぱい咲くかな？
lines.en: Yeah, secret! Hey, will lots of flowers bloom?
lines.style: Bright eager child voice, taking mom's hand happily

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ええ、きっとね。さあ、お靴を履いて出発しましょう。
lines.en: Yes, surely. Now, put on your shoes and let's set off.
lines.style: Soft warm motherly encouragement, ready to head outside together
